sections.title: Differentiating Relative Pronouns in Descriptions
sections.content: You know *aki* (who: for people), *ami* and *amely* (which, that: for things) from A2 Unit 4. *Ami* can also point back to a whole clause: *Sok bolt van a városban, ami nagyon kényelmes.* (There are many shops in the town, which is very convenient.)

items.spanish: A település, amely a folyó mellett van, nagyon csendes.
items.english: The town that is by the river is very quiet.

items.spanish: Az emberek, akik itt élnek, szeretik a csendes utcákat.
items.english: The people who live here like the quiet streets.

items.spanish: Sok park van a városban, ami nagyon jó.
items.english: There are many parks in the town, which is very good.
